hard_constraints: Single close-third POV from Ben Skywalker; no head-hopping or omniscient narration.
Use Star Wars Legends terminology: datapad (not laptop/computer), comm (not radio), Steady Returns (italicized ship name).
Do not use in-universe meta-terms like 'Legends' or 'Canon'; reference events by name (e.g., 'Fate of the Jedi', 'Abeloth crisis') only if character-appropriate.
Force descriptions: experiential/sensory first (e.g., diffused, unreliable), diagnostic terms (e.g., 'Weave', 'seal') earned by sensation; avoid 'reached for the Force' repeats.
Capitalize 'Human(s)' if appearing; lowercase 'galaxy', 'Jedi' plural as 'Jedi'.
canon_risks: Ben's direct reporting to Luke assumes post-FotJ Knight-to-Grand Master access; Legends supports informal Skywalker family protocols but confirm no formal GAG-era barriers persist.

Jedi Order response time to Outer Rim crisis: post-FotJ Order is stretched thin (post-Abeloth settling); plan's 'reply window' fits but risks underestimating Coruscant Temple bureaucracy if drafter inflates speed.
YT-series freighter (Steady Returns) straining with five aboard: Legends specs allow but emphasize cramped conditions without contradicting hyperdrive/atmospheric limits.
legends_continuity_notes: 47 ABY post-FotJ: Jedi Order reformed on Coruscant under Grand Master Luke Skywalker; Ben Skywalker is a seasoned Jedi Knight with GAG/Abeloth experience, trusted for solo missions.
Galactic Alliance primary government; Jedi independent but coordinated via Temple comms; Knights report crises directly to superiors like Luke for high-threat anomalies.

Ruusan Reformations (1000 BBY): canonical Legends event as post-New Sith Wars public restructuring, including Jedi demilitarization, end of Jedi Lords/Army of Light structures, centralized training, and closer Republic/Judicial oversight; concealed Veranthos penance layer authorized but must not override public history in prose.
Brotherhood of Darkness: Legends canonical (Darth Bane era, Kaan-led); Veranthos ritual/AU anchors do not conflict.
